</aside></div><div class="foot">Локальный автономный прототип. В GitHub ничего не загружено. Выход в общий автомат требует подключения события oldfag:exit-minigame в родительском приложении. За основу взят пользовательский Excel <b>posm_shop_level_editor_v01(2).xlsx</b>. const $=id=>document.getElementById(id),canvas=$('board'),viewport=$('viewport'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d',{alpha:false});

const CUSTOMER_SPRITE_VARIANTS=['male','female','elder'];
const CUSTOMER_DIRS=['down','up','left','right'];
const CUSTOMER_ACTIONS={idle:1,walk:3,take:2};
const CUSTOMER_VARIANT_BY_CODE={А:'male',Д:'female',Т:'elder',П:'male',Б:'female',С:'female'};
const customerSpriteImages={};
// Candy packages (approved pixel-art). Embedded so this HTML plays offline.
const CANDY_PACKAGE_DATA={toffifee:'data:image/png;base64,',merci:'data:image/png;base64,'};
const candyPackageImages={};
for(const [brand,data] of Object.entries(CANDY_PACKAGE_DATA)){
const img=new Image();img.src=data;candyPackageImages[brand]=img;
}
// Products are tied to the *source display*, never to a shopper's character.
function drawCandyPackage(o){
if(!o.hasCandy)return;
const brand=o.purchasedKind==='theater'?'merci':'toffifee';
const img=candyPackageImages[brand];
if(!img||!img.complete||!img.naturalWidth)return;
const x=o.x*TILE,y=o.y*TILE;
const dir=o.dir||'down';
// World coordinates: x/y refer to the customer's FOOT position, not their head.
// Follow the free carrying hand (or the basket on the rear view). Keep the
// approved 24px package size; only its position changes with facing direction.
const handOffset={
down:{x:16,y:1},    // visible free hand at lower right of front-facing sprite
up:{x:17,y:3},      // basket/right hand behind the back, below the shoulders
left:{x:-18,y:-1},  // hand extended in walking direction
right:{x:19,y:-1}   // hand extended in walking direction
}[dir]||{x:16,y:1};
const width=24,height=width*img.naturalHeight/img.naturalWidth;
const cx=x+handOffset.x,cy=y+handOffset.y;
ctx.save();ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=true;ctx.imageSmoothingQuality='high';
if(o.candyCount>1){
// For a double Merci sale, two boxes are held together at the same hand.
// The second box sits behind the first, slightly outwards (not over the face).
const outward=dir==='left'?-5:5;
ctx.drawImage(img,cx-width/2+outward,cy-height/2-3,width,height);
}
ctx.drawImage(img,cx-width/2,cy-height/2,width,height);
ctx.restore();
}
